correctness.rationale: Forty-eight explicit lines over F25 all satisfy the equation; exact F25 Gaussian elimination determines their 48x48 intersection matrix of rank 20 and discriminant -64 in a 20-line integer basis. Schütt–Shioda–van Luijk supplies char-0 integral geometric line generation; Kummer and smooth proper base change exclude non-5 torsion in specialization, and the two-dimensional H2 complement with eigenvalues -3±4i excludes a Picard jump. The index is a 5-power whose square divides 64, hence one. Trace lattice HNF has rank 8, determinant -4096 and Smith factors 2^6,8^2; mod-2 rank 8 rules out any invariant half class since 2NS^Frob is contained in traces. Standalone verify.py replays line intersections, integer bases and 255 mod-2 combinations, plus F5/F25 counts. Deligne purity, Kummer and trace formula are explicitly invoked rather than numerically certified.
